## Lecture materials

**Computational lectures on magnetic reconnection** *(in preparation)*<br>
Self-contained lectures on Sweet–Parker scaling and fast reconnection, worked
through with multi-fluid simulations in [Gkeyll](https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll)
and analyzed with [postgkyl](https://github.com/gkeyllorg/postgkyl), including
instructions for installing and running both on your own laptop.
